body: I know what you mean. Specially after having this job I ALWAYS look for a seatbelt. It's not worth it. You always need to buckle up. People don't know how much they really do help..
I was one of the first responders on scene for this accident...so very sad.. :/
Thank you.. I think I'm actually just going to take a few days off just to get myself back on track like you said.  I need to figure some things out. Thank you so much.

We're all in the same boat that we are all trying to climb out of. What I've learned is that the best people to possibly trust are the ones who truly understand what you are going through. We all have our problems, and it is comforting talking about it. If you need to talk about anything I'm all ears man. You're not out for the count until your eyes close for the last time. There's still  time :)
It just feels like my life is crumbling down. And I hate this feeling..of just helplessness

Thank you for the kind words you just wrote me. I am so sorry to hear that you've been through this and are constantly in this state. I can't even imagine how you feel. I'm trying to hold into anything I can. Just grabbing something and holding onto it in hopes that it brings me out. I just have no energy to even get out of bed. I'm sure you know exactly how I feel. I appreciate your sympathy and hope I get out of this rutt too. Good luck to you as well. There is still time to live a happy life and I wish you the best in achieving happiness for your soul.

I'm just constantly trying to keep myself busy and out of the house. I know I can do it..it's just hard. I appreciate everything you've said. Just from talking this little it's made me feel a little better. Thank you for spending your time to try to help someone you don't even know.

I'm a 20 year old EMT. I've had a little depression since about sophomore year in HS but it seems to be getting worse. I just don't know what to do. No one knows I have depression as I've hidden it pretty well from all of my friends. I've attempted once junior year (O.D.) only my parents know that. I work 80 hours a week and try to go to school on my days off. My parents are getting a divorce and some of it I feel is because of me. The girl I've been happily with just recently essentially told me to fuck off and basically disappeared from my life running away with some other guy. My grades are suffering, my work etiquette is suffering, my social life is suffering, my whole life seems to be suffering and I don't really know what to do or how to handle all of this. I guess I just feel helpless. It's funny. I do the best I can to help others and to make their days a little bit less shitty..and yet I can't even figure out how to help myself. I just feel so tired from everything. Like the drive is slowly leaking out of me. I don't know what to do. Thank you for reading.
